rule: Verify only safety and functional invariants; never require incidental counts, tags, history, or artifacts that do not change safety or function.
required: Every packet enumerates each stage's invariant list.
Safety boundaries, exact resource identities, digest identities, ordering, deadlines, bounded counts and zero-state cleanup remain exact.
prohibited: Tag totals when exact required tag values are not a safety boundary
Pre-existing incidental state not required for safety or function
